pr_title: feat: health and readiness check of prometheus server in CLI (promtool)
pr_body:
### Explanation
The proposal is to add new subcommands to `promtool`,  that allow users to check the health and readiness status of a local Prometheus server. This approach is similar to what Traefik, another software project, does by adding a healthcheck command to its CLI to test if the local server is up. The proposed subcommands would internally call the existing `/-/healthy` and `/-/ready` endpoints on the local server to perform the checks

### Related Issue 
Closes #12000 

### Proposed Changes
Two new subcommands to check command 
- healthy
- ready

CheckServerHealth() & CheckServerReadiness() takes URL as input, and if URL is not provided by the user then it will be default URL i.e `http://localhost:9090`

**Usage**
`./promtool check healthy`
`./promtool check ready`
or
`./promtool check healthy http://localhost:9090`
`./promtool check ready http://localhost:9090`

### Proof Manifests 
Since there are existing testcases (`web/web_test.go`) covering api endpoints  `/-/ healthy `and` /-/ready`, removed the redundant from this new subcommands


```
$ ./promtool check healthy
  SUCCESS: Prometheus Server is Healthy.

$ ./promtool check ready 
  SUCCESS: Prometheus Server is Ready.
```

issue_context.title: Add a healthcheck command to the CLI (or at least the Docker image)
issue_context.body:
### Proposal

Similar to https://github.com/prometheus/prometheus/pull/10366 but I am thinking more like traefik's approach which is to add a `healthcheck` command to the CLI that tests if the local server is up.  It does not need to do it via a public API and may have more robust checks that can only be done internally.
comments:
I suggest implementing `promtool` subcommands for checking the health and readiness status of local Prometheus servers. These subcommands would call the existing `/-/healthy` and `/-/ready` endpoints on the local server, respectively. 

Please let me know if this approach is aligned with what you had in mind.

If more robust checks were needed, it could be done by having promtool query Prometheus directly, much like the existing promtool query command, does it satisfy your needs?
that should be fine `traefik` just adds a subcommand anyway.

I was able to get a quick and basic version of this working in #12112:

```bash
~/go/src/github.com/prometheus/prometheus (feat/promtool-cli-health-check [  ]) -> ./promtool-test check server 'http://localhost:9090' 'healthy'
Prometheus Server is Healthy.

~/go/src/github.com/prometheus/prometheus (feat/promtool-cli-health-check [  ]) -> !!:s/healthy/ready/
./promtool-test check server 'http://localhost:9090' 'ready'
Prometheus Server is Ready.

```

The PR is marked as a draft for the time being because I haven't added support for TLS/basic auth or tests yet, but please feel free to provide feedback on implementation there.
